tokens.name: gm-1000
tokens.usage: Keylines: the 1px dark edge around buttons, panels, and editor seams. Never a fill for content.

tokens.name: gm-950
tokens.usage: Viewport background, field and NumberField fill, menubar, status bar, vertical tab strip.

tokens.name: gm-900
tokens.usage: App window background behind editors; zebra rows in the outliner; timeline ruler.

tokens.name: gm-800
tokens.usage: Editor and panel surface (outliner, properties, timeline). The default ground for text.

tokens.name: gm-700
tokens.usage: Raised controls: buttons, selects, keycaps; row hover.

tokens.name: gm-600
tokens.usage: Button hover; type badge fill; separators inside menus.

tokens.name: gm-500
tokens.usage: Non-selected inner mesh edges in the viewport; timeline spans. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Border on fields, NumberFields, checkboxes, and graft slots. 3:1 on gm-800 and gm-700.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and values on every gm surface (10:1 or better) and on amber-deep.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Property labels, secondary text, idle icons, viewport overlay text. 5:1 or better on gm-600 through gm-1000.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholders only. 4.2:1 on gm-800; never for live labels.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Selection and the active state: selected outline in the viewport, active tab icon, changed values, primary button fill, dirty dot. 6:1 on gm-800.

tokens.name: amber-bright
tokens.usage: The ACTIVE item inside a selection (active outliner row text, object origin); primary button hover.

tokens.name: amber-deep
tokens.usage: Solid selection fill behind selected rows, toggled buttons, and hot menu items. Takes ink, amber, or amber-bright text.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and checkmarks on amber and amber-bright fills.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Time and reference: timeline playhead, hardpoint markers, graft ghost geometry, links. 6:1 on gm-800.

tokens.name: steel-deep
tokens.usage: Slider fill inside a NumberField that has a bounded range.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 1px solid, 1px offset. 6:1 on gm-800, 7:1 on gm-950.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Validated / packaged / round-trip clean. Always paired with a check icon or word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, failed validation. 4.8:1 on gm-800; always paired with a warning icon or word.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: X axis: gizmo, grid axis line, X labels in vector fields. 4.9:1 on gm-950.

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Y axis: gizmo, grid axis line, Y labels in vector fields. 8:1 on gm-950.

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: Z axis: gizmo, Z labels in vector fields. 5.4:1 on gm-950.

tokens.name: checker-light
tokens.usage: Transparency checkerboard behind masked PIC pixels, light squares. Never a UI surface.

tokens.name: checker-dark
tokens.usage: Transparency checkerboard behind masked PIC pixels, dark squares. Never a UI surface.
